display_name: Salesforce: Log In To An Org
description: Log the sf CLI in to a Salesforce org and bind it, through the CLI's documented login commands; flags takes every documented flag of the chosen command by its CLI name. method web runs sf org login web (flags browser, client-id, instance-url, set-default, set-default-dev-hub, alias, client-app with username, scopes): the operator's browser opens and the job waits up to 5 minutes for sign-in. method jwt runs sf org login jwt for unattended use (flags username and client-id required, instance-url, set-default, set-default-dev-hub, alias) with the connected app's private key either from the vault secret named in jwt_key_secret, written to a 0600 file only while a CLI call for that org runs because the CLI re-reads it on every session refresh, or from the jwt-key-file flag. method sfdx_url runs sf org login sfdx-url with the force:// auth URL from the vault secret named in sfdx_auth_url_secret (sent on standard input) or the sfdx-url-file flag. method access_token runs sf org login access-token (instance-url required) with the token from the vault secret named in access_token_secret, passed in SF_ACCESS_TOKEN. The operator stores each secret once with service_interface::vault_service::store_from_file under <solet>.salesforce_plugin.org_secret__<name>; this verb takes only <name>. --no-prompt and --sfdx-url-stdin are set by the plugin. The logged-in org is then bound as bind_org does, with alias and make_default. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Log in to a Salesforce org and connect it to this solet: interactively in the browser, or unattended with a JWT connected app key, an SFDX auth URL or an access token kept in the vault. Use to add a production org, sandbox or Dev Hub, or to restore a session after logout. Secrets are named, never passed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: method, binding (org_id, alias, target_org, username, instance_host, org_type, is_dev_hub, login_method, jwt_key_secret, secret_names, default), org (the alias) and org_id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm which user and org the login reached and the alias it is bound under. Never ask for or repeat a secret's value; a vault secret is referred to by its name.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Log the sf CLI in to an org and bind it.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: method is not web, jwt, sfdx_url or access_token, a flag is undocumented, plugin-set or of the wrong type, a required flag is missing, a secret name is malformed, a jwt or sfdx_url login names both or neither of its key sources, or the alias, username or CLI target of the logged-in org already names another bound org. sf.not_configured: the named vault secret holds no value. sf.auth_failed: the CLI login failed; when the login carried a vault secret only the CLI's error name and a fixed hint are returned, never the CLI's message. sf.import_path_refused: a key or auth URL file lies outside the saved path addresses.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jwt: check the consumer key, that the user is pre-authorized for the connected app, that the app certificate matches the stored key and that instance-url is the login URL. sfdx_url: store a current force:// URL. access_token: store a current token. Store a missing secret with vault_service store_from_file, then log in again.
